title: Lifting a contract to a larger alphabet
statement: Let $e$ embed the two Boolean symbols into an alphabet, and let a machine with Boolean symbols have transitions independent of the scanned input symbol and never write a blank onto a work tape. For any contract for this machine on the input obtained by replacing every symbol of a given input word by false, the lifted machine has a contract on that word: its precondition, running time, endpoint, and head-position bounds are those of the original contract applied to the configuration decoded through $e$.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding of Boolean symbols into the alphabet
Transitions are independent of the input symbol
No transition writes a blank onto a work tape
A contract for the Boolean machine on the all-false input of the same length
